title: Where can you fly direct from East Midlands Airport?
author: Matt
intro: East Midlands is a short-haul airport, with Jet2, Ryanair and TUI all based there. It has a record 45 direct routes in 2026, mostly to sunny Spain, Portugal and Greece, plus some good city breaks. Here's what flies, what's new for winter 2026/27 and how to choose.
seo_title: Direct flights from East Midlands: 2026/27 routes
seo_description: Jet2, Ryanair and TUI to Spain, the Canaries, Portugal and Greece, plus new winter flights to Agadir, Gdansk and Budapest. What flies from East Midlands.

sections.heading: East Midlands at a glance
sections.text:
East Midlands Airport sits between Nottingham, Derby and Leicester. **Jet2**, **Ryanair** and **TUI** all have aircraft based there, and between them they fly most of the routes. Ryanair carries roughly half of the airport's passengers.

The airport says it has **45 direct routes in 2026**, a record. Almost all of them are short and medium-haul flights to Europe, North Africa and Turkey. There are no regular long-haul flights, so for the Caribbean, the USA or Asia, most people go from Birmingham or Manchester.

Routes change every season, so check the airport's [A to Z of destinations](https://www.eastmidlandsairport.com/destinations-and-guides/a-z-list-of-destinations/) and the airline's own timetable before you plan around a flight. We checked these routes in October 2026.

sections.heading: What's new for winter 2026/27
sections.text:
A few new routes are worth knowing about this winter:

- **Agadir, Morocco (Jet2):** a weekly flight from November 2026 to March 2027. Agadir is warm and sunny in winter, and only an hour ahead of the UK.
- **Gdansk, Poland (Jet2):** a short Christmas season, with flights on Mondays and Fridays from **27 November to 21 December 2026**. Gdansk's Christmas market is one of the prettiest in Poland.
- **Budapest (Ryanair):** a new route for winter 2026/27, good for thermal baths and Christmas markets.

For summer 2026, Jet2 added **Chania** in Crete, **Preveza** and **Thessaloniki** in Greece, **Pula** and **Split** in Croatia, and the **Costa de Almería**. **SunExpress** arrived with flights to **Antalya**, and TUI brought back **Sharm el-Sheikh** and flies to **Boa Vista** in Cape Verde.

sections.heading: Winter sun
sections.text:
The **Canary Islands** are the backbone of the winter timetable from East Midlands. Between them, Jet2, Ryanair and TUI usually cover **Tenerife**, **Lanzarote**, **Gran Canaria** and **Fuerteventura**, with flights of around four hours. Expect highs of about 20 to 22°C in December and January.

Closer to home, the **Costa del Sol** (Málaga), **Alicante** and the **Algarve** (Faro) are about two and a half hours away. They are milder rather than hot in winter, at around 16 to 18°C, but often sunny, and good for walking, golf and city sightseeing.

For something more exotic, **Agadir** in Morocco joins this winter, with highs of around 21°C in December and a long sandy beach. TUI's **Sharm el-Sheikh** flights were part of its summer 2026 programme, so check whether they're running when you want to go.

Which airline flies each route, and how often, varies through the season, so compare before you book.

sections.heading: City breaks
sections.text:
East Midlands isn't only for beach holidays. The airport's list of destinations includes **Barcelona**, **Prague** and **Dublin**, and this winter adds **Budapest** and **Gdansk**. Most are two hours or less, so they work well for a long weekend.

In December, these cities come into their own with Christmas markets. Prague's Old Town Square and Budapest's Vörösmarty Square are famous, and Gdansk's market sits in a beautifully rebuilt old town. For help choosing, see our posts on [Vienna or Prague at Christmas](/blog/vienna-or-prague-at-christmas) and [Budapest or Krakow at Christmas](/blog/budapest-or-krakow-at-christmas).

Remember that many winter routes from regional airports only fly two or three times a week. The timetable may decide whether your trip is three nights or four.

sections.heading: Getting to East Midlands
sections.text:
There's no railway station at the airport, so most people drive, take a taxi or use the **Skylink** buses, which run around the clock to Nottingham, Derby, Leicester and nearby towns.

If you're being dropped off, the **Rapid Drop Off** zone outside the terminal went up to **£8 for up to 10 minutes** on 29 September 2026. It has no barriers: cameras read your number plate, and you pay online or by phone by midnight the next day, or risk a £100 charge. The **long stay car park** is free for up to an hour, but it's about a 10-minute walk to the terminal.

Ryanair is also changing its rules: from **10 November 2026**, its bag drop closes **60 minutes before departure**. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Birmingham Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-birmingham-airport) covers timings at a similar-sized Midlands airport.

sections.heading: How to pick from the departures list
sections.text:
Start with how much travel time you want. From East Midlands, a city break is usually two hours or less, the Spanish mainland and Portugal about two and a half, and the Canaries and Agadir around four. On a short trip, every hour in the air eats into your holiday.

Then think about what the trip is for. For reliable warmth in winter, the Canaries and Agadir are the safest choices. For culture, food and Christmas markets, a European city is easier to fit in. In summer, the Greek islands, Croatia and Turkey come into play, with longer flights but hotter weather and warm seas.

Finally, look at prices across the whole week. On routes that only fly twice a week, the cheapest days may decide your dates for you.

sections.heading: Where could you go from East Midlands?
sections.text:
Ideas from our guides that you can reach directly from East Midlands, depending on the season:

- [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) or [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) for winter sun.
- [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) for a mild winter city break by the sea.
- [Gdansk](/destinations/gdansk), [Budapest](/destinations/budapest) or [Prague](/destinations/prague) for Christmas markets.
- [Split](/destinations/split) or [Crete](/destinations/crete) for summer.

For more inspiration, browse our [winter sun ideas for December](/destinations/where-to-go-in-december) or our guide to [how to decide where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday).

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from East Midlands Airport?
faqs.answer: Jet2, Ryanair and TUI all have aircraft based there and fly most routes. SunExpress also flies to Antalya in summer. Check the airport's website for the latest list.

faqs.question: Can you fly long-haul from East Midlands?
faqs.answer: Not on regular scheduled flights. East Midlands is mainly a short and medium-haul airport. For long-haul, most people use Birmingham or Manchester.

faqs.question: What new routes are there from East Midlands for winter 2026/27?
faqs.answer: Jet2 is adding weekly flights to Agadir from November 2026 and a Christmas season to Gdansk from 27 November to 21 December. Ryanair is adding Budapest.

faqs.question: How much is drop-off at East Midlands Airport?
faqs.answer: From 29 September 2026, the Rapid Drop Off zone costs £8 for up to 10 minutes, paid online or by phone by midnight the next day. The long stay car park is free for up to an hour.
